scope: All 27 existing open issues, acceptance audit against shipped source and delivery evidence

issues.title: [MVP tracker] Sugar Maple — local-first UI design, preview and developer handoff
issues.delivered: The Canvas port and QA-01–QA-10 are merged in PR #45.
issues.remaining: MVP completion depends on the remaining acceptance criteria below; post-MVP features remain outside the release gate.

issues.title: [MVP] Validate HTML + SVG whiteboard architecture and record RFC decisions
issues.delivered: Actual Just-Maple Whiteboard Canvas2D is integrated. DOM preview/export and shared scene truth remain; Canvas/DOM parity fixtures pass.
issues.remaining: Record end-to-end p95 frame/startup/memory on the agreed mixed-node fixture in both engines and a 10,000-node diagnostic. CPU flush timings do not satisfy that gate.

issues.title: [MVP] Bootstrap reproducible Angular and macOS development builds
issues.delivered: Pinned workspace and lockfile, production web bundle, macOS 15 target, offline bundled editor, and local Mac builds are implemented. This cleanup adds a macOS CI build and real native filesystem fixtures.
issues.remaining: Close after the new clean-checkout macOS CI job passes; development signing does not imply notarized distribution.

issues.title: [MVP] Integrate the existing _Maple UI library and tokens
issues.delivered: Narrow, vendored Maple Button/Select/Field/Icon primitives and generated chrome tokens are documented; no sibling checkout or photo backend is required.
issues.remaining: Finish source inventory, update procedure/notices, and explicit chrome specimen/light-dark acceptance. Do not equate the existing subset with the complete Maple catalog.

issues.title: [MVP] Bundle the editor in WKWebView with a typed native bridge
issues.delivered: Bundled WKWebView, native dialogs/menu routing and typed error preservation are implemented. This cleanup validates the app hostname, resource containment, and package symbolic-link rejection.
issues.remaining: Exercise fresh empty-cache/offline startup, inaccessible-file and capability fallbacks, complete exactly-once keyboard/native clipboard behavior and a real hostile-frame bridge attempt. Custom pasteboard payload is also tracked by #18.

issues.title: [MVP] Define the scene graph and validate the CRDT and undo contract
issues.delivered: Versioned semantic scene, Yjs field maps, atomic commands, origin-aware grouped undo, journal replay and a bounded Automerge/Yjs diagnostic are implemented.
issues.remaining: Complete comparative text/drag/reparent/delete/convergence fixtures, unknown-field migration contract, repeated startup/memory/growth measurements and a final CRDT/storage decision.

issues.title: [MVP] Implement local .syrup persistence, autosave and crash recovery
issues.delivered: Managed/named packages, serial autosave, immutable history snapshots, external-conflict protection, browser IndexedDB, native recovery and forced-restart history are verified.
issues.remaining: Canonical manifest/scenes/tokens/assets/log package, append/compaction crash injection, quota/disk-full/permission fixtures and coordinated final writes remain. Current checkpoints have a 32 MB limit.

issues.title: [MVP] Adapt Just-Maple whiteboard navigation and selection to the hybrid renderer
issues.delivered: Vendored Whiteboard camera, pan/zoom/fit, culling, mixed geometry, hit testing, drag/corner resize, cancellation and grouped undo are delivered. Layers indexing is linear.
issues.remaining: Finish all-direction resize/rotation editing, snapping/distribution, rotated-parent gesture coverage, complete locked/hidden keyboard parity and Layers DOM virtualization. Canvas replaced the obsolete hybrid Design renderer.

issues.title: [MVP] Add artboards, drawing primitives, editable text and layers
issues.delivered: Artboards/frames/groups/basic geometry/text/images, layers inspector, editable multiline text and saved sign-in design fixtures exist.
issues.remaining: Finish interactive path/freehand/connector tooling, complete reparent world-placement behavior and real Unicode/IME/caret/local-font acceptance. Rich typography is a dedicated follow-up.

issues.title: [MVP] Implement CSS stacks, grid and responsive constraints
issues.delivered: Free/row/column/basic grid, gap/padding, fixed/fill/hug/percent and representative Canvas/DOM parity within 1 CSS px are verified.
issues.remaining: Implement wrap, bounded fr/minmax/auto-fit, full manual pins/child constraints and stack drag reorder. Verify each supported rule in Canvas, browser/WKWebView preview and web consumers.

issues.title: [MVP] Add design token import, bindings and CSS export
issues.delivered: Document-owned opaque sRGB colors, color aliases, bindings, literal precedence and color token import/export are implemented.
issues.remaining: Extend typed registry to dimension/radius/typography/shadow and light/dark modes; pin the supported DTCG version and cover aliases/cycles/mode round trips.

issues.title: [MVP] Build the component registry, library picker and instance overrides
issues.delivered: Local masters/instances, recursive structural propagation, named style variants, local overrides, detach/reset and dependency-complete paste are verified.
issues.remaining: Production registry metadata/props/slots/states, Checkbox, optional library mappings and compatible component swaps with loss previews remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Implement Repeat Grid with text and image data overrides
issues.delivered: Undoable Repeat Grid creation and text population, deterministic preview/export and checkpoint round trips exist.
issues.remaining: Replace eager structural cloning with template/per-cell semantics; retain stable cell IDs on resize; add image overrides, named field mapping, CSV/JSON validation and grid handles.

issues.title: [MVP] Add isolated responsive preview and click-through prototyping
issues.delivered: Cross-page click navigation, Back, reset/viewport presets, real dissolve with reduced-motion behavior and separate inspection are implemented.
issues.remaining: Add overlay open/close, typed/secure inputs and state preservation; verify invalid-target diagnostics and real native isolated-preview cleanup.

issues.title: [MVP] Show component names, tokens and code targets in developer preview
issues.delivered: Inspector exposes authored name, local master/instance/variant/override identity and working portable copy actions.
issues.remaining: Show production design-system source/version/platform mappings, state, token identity and authored-versus-measured rules; verify nested keyboard inspection and each advertised copy payload.

issues.title: [MVP] Copy portable Angular, semantic HTML, Tailwind 4 and CSS
issues.delivered: Standalone semantic HTML/CSS, Angular and Tailwind consumers compile/render; multiline whitespace, tokens and supported layout fixtures are verified.
issues.remaining: Optional mapped snippets require actual pinned library API verification. Complete classes-only payloads, asset/style packaging, accessible control attributes and action integration guidance.

issues.title: [MVP] Copy idiomatic SwiftUI with optional design-system mappings
issues.delivered: Standalone SwiftUI consumer compiles; all nine font weights and control/stack padding are covered. Unsupported path/gradient/responsive exports reject explicitly.
issues.remaining: Verify supported visual equivalence, enabled/state/secure-input semantics, self-contained image assets and optional pinned-library snippets. No CSS-to-SwiftUI parity claim.

issues.title: [MVP] Copy and paste editable UI elements across documents
issues.delivered: Versioned editable clipboard preserves nested master/variant/token dependencies, remaps identity and undoes atomically; browser envelope/native text fallback exists.
issues.remaining: Add native custom pasteboard type, permission-denied/manual fallback acceptance, sanitized HTML/common-Tailwind import allowlist and cross-app clipboard/assets tests. Arbitrary source remains unevaluated.

issues.title: [MVP] Import local assets and export selection as SVG or PNG
issues.delivered: Local raster assets, SVG/PNG supported exports, decode diagnostics, replacement and undo are implemented.
issues.remaining: Local fonts/catalog/crop-fit behavior, supported SVG import coverage, mixed-content 1x/2x export fixtures, cancellation and missing-font/oversize/external-asset cases remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Bring up the MCP server and live editor command loop early
issues.delivered: Real SDK HTTP/stdio operate on one native-owned editor document; grouped transactions, retries, revision-bound capture, typed validation/errors, token/Origin rejection and pointer readback are verified.
issues.remaining: Complete occupied-port, foreign-Host, disconnected/loading/timeouts and reconnect/cleanup transport fixtures plus versioned output schemas. Mac-first host supersedes the initial browser-host plan.

issues.title: [MVP] Validate the complete offline design-to-code workflow and package release
issues.delivered: Model/browser/consumer/native/MCP/recovery gates passed for PR #45; source/evidence and CI links are available.
issues.remaining: All remaining MVP acceptance, measured end-to-end performance/100 MB stress, VoiceOver/offline fresh-launch and release artifact/install/rollback/signing status must be recorded before release.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add peer collaboration, mobile companion and Git history
issues.delivered: No peer networking/mobile companion/Git integration was added by the Canvas port.
issues.remaining: Create a follow-up RFC and distinct peer/mobile/Git slices with convergence, authenticated pairing, input parity and conflict-recovery fixtures.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add advanced vector editing
issues.delivered: Basic paths/vector serialization exist; advanced geometry was not shipped.
issues.remaining: Define geometry fixtures and implement Bezier handles, booleans, masks and flattening in separate slices, with preview/export parity and profiling.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add prototype state machines, auto-animate and voice
issues.delivered: Click navigation/Back/dissolve are the current prototype subset.
issues.remaining: Variables/conditions/advanced triggers/auto-animate/springs/voice need separate deterministic supported-trigger slices and permission/offline/reduced-motion acceptance.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Extend code linkage and native export coverage
issues.delivered: Portable export and explicit unsupported diagnostics exist; arbitrary repository source is never implicitly executed.
issues.remaining: Add verified repository/Storybook linkage and named native targets. Production library manifests and isolated executable previews are now dedicated follow-ups.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add automatic responsive inference and advanced component behavior
issues.delivered: Manual supported layouts and simple local named variants exist.
issues.remaining: Automatic inference/explanations, advanced Grid, slots/nested contextual variants and image/vector-mask repeated overrides remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Extend the early MCP loop to complete feature coverage and native packaging
issues.delivered: Native HTTP/stdio, component/folder/comment commands, durable autosave, revision-bound capture and shared command schemas are verified.
issues.remaining: Expose only implemented feature tools, add versioned output schemas/examples, real MCP resources and remaining asset/library/prototype tools; test offline fresh launch, lifecycle and 10/s capture throttle.
